description: This file defines the SafeObjectInputStream class, a custom implementation extending ObjectInputStream to securely deserialize objects by enforcing allowlist and denylist patterns for class names.

classes.name: SafeObjectInputStream
classes.description: A secure extension of ObjectInputStream that restricts deserialization to approved classes based on allowlist and denylist patterns.

methods.name: SafeObjectInputStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stream with allowlist patterns based on configuration properties.

methods.name: resolveClass
methods.description: Overrides the method to enforce class name restrictions during deserialization, throwing exceptions for unauthorized classes.
